qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Entrenched architectural specification lock-in via certified hardware consultants embedding Schlage, Von Duprin, and LCN into Division 8/28 building schedules. Extreme switching costs from institutional master-key systems and strict life-safety fire/ADA compliance codes where liability prevents substitution. Empirical proof: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 23.9% (operating tangible ROIC ~97%), stable ~42-44% gross margins, and consistent pricing realization exceeding inflation. Primary erosion threat is electronic access control disintermediation, though Allegion effectively embeds EAC into its mechanical door footprints.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global leader in commercial, institutional, and residential security hardware and access solutions. Wide moat anchored by architectural specification dominance (Schlage, Von Duprin, LCN) and high-switching-cost master key installed bases. Insulated from AI disruption with tailwinds from electronic access integration. Strong cash conversion (~92% FCF/NI) and conservative balance sheet (~1.5x net debt/EBITDA, 8.5x interest coverage). [5-10Y g: institutional volume 2.0% + pricing power 2.5% + electronic access mix & bolt-ons 2.5% - integration/R&D drag 0.5% + net buybacks 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 23.9% and tangible operating ROIC of 96.7%. 10-year FCF conversion averages ~98% of net income with capex under 2.5% of sales. Americas segment generates ~80%+ of revenue and >27% operating margins driven by non-residential institutional retrofit and replacement cycles. Pristine balance sheet with net debt to EBITDA of ~1.5x and EBIT/Interest coverage of 8.5x.
